# Marketing

## Overview
The marketing efforts, promotional copy, and product positioning face several ongoing challenges, including print copy discrepancies, branding decisions, event coordination, and internal debates over product form factors. 

## Key Details
- **Print Copy & [Documentation](./documentation.md) Inconsistencies:** The herbal box copy in print proof v3 incorrectly lists brewing/steeping time as 5 minutes, whereas the marketing PDF states 5 minutes, the current [Firmware](./firmware.md) is set to 7 minutes, and the wiki reflects 7 minutes following the last compile. Team members discussed potential fixes, such as using a sticker overlay, but Sam Rivera mandated fixing the print directly.
- **Event Coordination:** [Aurora Nova Widget v2](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md) inquired about sharing a booth, but Sam Rivera rejected the proposal unless Aurora Mira agrees to pay half the costs.
- **[Product Naming](./product-naming.md) Brainstorming:** 
  - *Approved Names:* [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md) and [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md).
  - *Rejected Names:* SoilPal, GritNode, PetalPing, CloudFree Sensor, and KarpathyGarden.
- **Taglines Explored:** 
  - "Sense without surrender" (rejected as cringe)
  - "Your data, your dirt" (rejected as worse)
  - "Open [Sensors](./sensors.md) for people who own their data" (retained as a leading option)
- **Performance & Feedback:** Beta Net Promoter Score (NPS) stands at 42, with pairing complaints decreasing following version 0.9.3.
